resolved_issue: Developer request modal intermittently failing to appear after key operations
root_cause: Separate dialog transitions and exit animation presence could leave an invisible close overlay/focus layer intercepting immediate subsequent clicks. Dynamic dialog identity also caused a hidden-selector check to finish before the exiting overlay had unmounted.
fixes: Extracted DeveloperDialogs with one persistent Radix dialog for create, secret, action and test modes
Removed modal/overlay exit animations so close immediately releases pointer-event interception
Added explicit one-time-secret Done action and protected dismissal during requests
